preregistration.title: Split audit and group-aware re-analysis (v5)
preregistration.fixed_on: 2026-10-24, before any v5 result (results/v5) existed; inputs are the existing scores and features
preregistration.status: pre-specified validation of the split and calibration design; the original analyses and verdicts are preserved and reported unchanged; v5 adds evidence and changes no earlier verdict
preregistration.motivation: ASVspoof 2021 DF provides no source-recording link and the published counts imply several codec versions per bona fide source; earlier DF analyses treated each file as its own source; in both corpora the reference halves were drawn without source grouping; the gate and the guard reuse the calibration half that sets the anchor
preregistration.siblings_df21: blocks of equal label, speaker, attack and source corpus; candidate pairs whose speech duration after 40 dB trimming (runs/df21trim40_v1) differs by at most 0.10 s; linked if the cosine similarity of SSL-AASIST time-mean XLS-R features is at least theta, theta = 99.9th percentile of the cosine over same-block pairs whose trimmed durations differ by at least 0.50 s (up to 10 random pairs per trial, at most 2,000,000, fixed seed); sources = connected components; reported: theta, cosine distributions, component sizes, linked shares by label, codec and source corpus, and versions per source for ASVspoof-2019-derived bona fide trials
preregistration.groups_asv5: official source groups (protocol column codec_seed), as in every earlier ASVspoof 5 analysis

designs.A_original: the third test's main cell, primary features (identical references, traffic, halves and folds)
designs.B_grouped: same reference; halves assigned by source (random source order, filled to 500); traffic = original traffic without trials whose source is in the reference, spoofs removed at random to keep the spoof share; crossfit, gate, guard and anchors as specified
designs.C_grouped_independent_calibration: as B; calibration half split by source into selection (250, gate and guard) and final calibration (250, anchors only)

preregistration.held_out: per repetition a random sample of up to 5,000 genuine and 20,000 spoofed trials outside the reference and the traffic (A: by the groups of the original analysis; B, C: by source); scored with the fold-averaged adapted model or the frozen score; anchor from the calibration (A, B) or final-calibration (C) recordings scored the same way
preregistration.metrics: EER, anchor FRR (genuine rejection), FAR (spoof acceptance), HTER, shortcut AUC; traffic and held-out
preregistration.design_conditions: main conditions of the third test: both modes, all shares, 20 repetitions, three detectors

decision.robust_to_source_leakage: per detector and corpus: the PGA-G outcome of each of H1-H5 under B equals the outcome under A, and in every main condition |mean EER(B) - mean EER(A)| <= 0.5 point and |mean FRR(B) - mean FRR(A)| <= 1 point for PGA-G (traffic)
decision.independent_calibration: reported without decision: H1-H5 under C, held-out FRR of PGA-G under C (formal bound alpha = 0.05 under exchangeability), paired differences C - B
decision.reporting: every result is reported, whatever the outcome

preregistration.statistics: means over repetitions; paired differences with 95% percentile bootstrap intervals (4,000 resamples)
